profile.headline: Director of IT | Infrastructure, Security & Compliance | Technology Operations | Automation | SOC 2 Readiness
profile.summary:
Director of IT with a background in infrastructure, security, compliance, automation, and technology operations.
 
I serve as a senior technology leader across IT, infrastructure, security, and technical operations, including responsibilities typically aligned with CTO, CIO, and CISO functions in larger organizations. My experience includes leading multidisciplinary technical teams, building internal platforms, improving operational visibility, implementing SOC 2 readiness efforts, managing cloud/on-prem infrastructure, and aligning technology decisions with business priorities.
 
I’m focused on IT management, infrastructure leadership, and technology operations roles where I can help organizations scale systems, reduce manual work, improve reliability, strengthen compliance posture, and turn technical work into measurable business value.

positions.title: Director of IT
positions.description:
Serve as the organization’s senior technology leader, owning CTO, CIO, and CISO-aligned responsibilities across IT strategy, infrastructure, security, compliance, and technical execution.
 
Lead a multidisciplinary technical organization across backend, infrastructure, security, and operations, supporting core business systems and enterprise client requirements.
 
Define and execute technology strategy across cloud, on-prem infrastructure, data systems, endpoint management, security controls, and internal platforms.
 
Spearheaded development of an internal miner management solution that replaced costly third-party tooling, reducing software costs by 89% while improving data accessibility and executive decision-making.
 
Began implementing security and compliance frameworks, including SOC 2 readiness, privacy controls, access governance, and client regulatory requirements.
 
Partner with executive stakeholders to translate business priorities into scalable systems, automation, governance, and operational improvements.

positions.title: Regional Manager for Power and IT Services
positions.description:
Served as a senior technical leader across multi-site power, IT, and infrastructure operations, owning reliability, automation, systems visibility, and operational tooling.
 
Led development of a large-scale endpoint management platform supporting tens of thousands of devices, enabling centralized control, automation, and operational visibility.
 
Drove automation initiatives that reduced accounts receivable processing time by 40%, improving financial operations and reducing manual overhead.
 
Implemented enterprise asset management systems, including CMDB/CMMS, improving asset visibility, lifecycle tracking, and operational efficiency.

positions.title: Data Center Operations Manager
positions.description:
Led operations for large-scale data center environments, maintaining 98%+ uptime through process optimization and automation.
 
Managed a team of 20+ technicians, improving productivity, incident response, and operational workflows.
 
Introduced centralized monitoring and reporting systems, enhancing visibility and reducing time to resolution for operational issues.

positions.title: Data Center Operations Manager
positions.description:
Managed data center operations with responsibility for uptime, technician coordination, backlog management, infrastructure reliability, and operational execution.
 
Improved system uptime by 8% through operational restructuring, automation initiatives, monitoring improvements, and process standardization.
 
Streamlined backlog management and task prioritization processes, reducing operational bottlenecks and improving execution across site teams.
 
Implemented monitoring and automation tooling across infrastructure systems to improve visibility, response times, and operational consistency.
 
Partnered with technical and operations teams to translate recurring site issues into process improvements, tooling, and automation opportunities.

positions.title: Junior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and delivered automation and data systems enabling real-time operational insights across infrastructure and data center environments.
 
Developed internal tools that reduced issue resolution time by 20%, improving troubleshooting speed and operational efficiency.
 
Built automation capabilities that generated approximately $500K in annual revenue through new operational opportunities.
 
Created reporting and visibility tools that helped operations teams identify infrastructure issues, prioritize work, and reduce manual tracking.
 
Worked across systems engineering, automation, monitoring, and operational support to improve reliability in large-scale infrastructure environments.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Built internal dashboards using Python, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript to aggregate operational metrics across 11 cloud providers.
 
Verified and triaged bugs submitted by technicians, coordinating issue reproduction, documentation, and handoff to engineering.
 
Trained new QA technicians in testing workflows, bug reporting standards, troubleshooting procedures, and internal tooling.
 
Managed office network operations, including connectivity, troubleshooting, device support, and day-to-day IT reliability.
 
Introduced Selenium automation to reduce manual QA testing workload and improve testing consistency.

positions.title: Operations Technician
positions.description:
Supported cloud infrastructure operations, monitoring, and troubleshooting across multi-provider environments.
 
Built early automation and observability tooling that improved reporting, QA workflows, and operational visibility.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Led a team of approximately 30 and turned around an underperforming location into the district’s top-earning store with the lowest labor cost.

positions.title: Assistant Food and Beverage Manager
positions.description: Managed day-to-day operations for a $6.4M annual revenue business with 100+ total employees during peak seasonal traffic, including acting site leadership responsibilities during General Manager vacancies

projects.title: Scanner
projects.description: Rust + Svelte desktop app to scan and control port assigned ASIC miners.

projects.title: libminer
projects.description: Async library to abstract querying and control of a variety of ASIC miners
